description: Make a link that asks someone to pay your Gloam address privately. It opens Pay in the Gloam app with the address, amount, asset and note filled in; the payer checks and sends. The details ride after the # of the link, so the payer's browser never sends them to a server. Needs your public Gloam address (gloamr1.…), never a key.

amount.description: Amount in whole units, e.g. "12.50". Leave out to let the payer choose.

asset.description: Token symbol or address, e.g. USDG on Robinhood Chain, OUSD or PathUSD on Tempo. Default: the network's main stablecoin.

name.description: Your name as the payer should see it (up to 40 characters).

network.description: Gloam network: "robinhood-mainnet" (Robinhood Chain mainnet: USDG and GLOAM), "tempo-mainnet" (Tempo mainnet: USDC.e, pathUSD, USDT0, OUSD), "base-mainnet" (Base mainnet: USDC, EURC, USDT, ETH), "ethereum-mainnet" (Ethereum mainnet: USDC, USDT, USDG, PYUSD, EURC, ETH), or a testnet: "tempo" (Tempo Moderato), "robinhood" (Robinhood Chain testnet), "base" (Base Sepolia) or "ethereum" (Ethereum Sepolia).

note.description: A reference the payer sees, e.g. "Invoice 042" (up to 80 characters).

to.description: Your Gloam address to be paid at, gloamr1.… (public; find it in the app under Receive).

name: gloam_create_payment_request
title: Create a payment request link
